Usage Credits: Customer will receive a bill credit of $50 when usage is at
least 1000 kWh but less than 2000 kWh in a billing cycle. Customer will

cycle.

Does the REP purchase excess distributed renewable generation? No

Type of Product: Fixed Rate
Contract Term: 12 Months

Do I have a termination fee or any fees associated with terminating service?
Yes, Champion will assess a termination fee of $200 if service is terminated
before the end of the Contract Term.
